description: Common issues and solutions for Mindcraft AI agents in Minecraft

patterns.name: Water Avoidance
patterns.rule: NEVER send agents near water. Water blocks are deadly traps.
patterns.solution: Check for water within 5 blocks before moving. Avoid all water biomes.

patterns.name: Night Survival
patterns.rule: Agents must seek shelter or safety at night (Time > 12000).
patterns.solution: Return to base/shelter before 12000. Carry torches. Do not wander.

patterns.name: Human Assistance
patterns.rule: Human players take priority over all autonomous tasks.
patterns.solution: Pause current goal. Greet player. Ask for instructions.
